description: Add `make reinstall` target for one-command rebuild cycle
steps: Add `reinstall` to the .PHONY list in the Makefile

Add a `reinstall` target after the `install` target that: (1) runs osascript -e 'quit app "Ledge"' with || true to ignore errors if not running, (2) sleep 1, (3) runs the install target (which depends on app which depends on build), (4) runs open /Applications/Ledge.app
acceptance_criteria: Makefile has a `reinstall` target with graceful quit, sleep, install, and open steps
Running `swift test` still passes all 54 tests
verification: Run `swift test` and confirm all 54 tests pass
